OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already has the same last name and address (i.e. they knowingly share a
            household). When false or omitted, such a create is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already has the same last name and address (i.e. they knowingly share a
            household). When false or omitted, such a create is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false

        - firstName
        - lastName

        - telephone

## Summary

I implemented the shared-household feature in the Spring Boot PetClinic REST app. The scaffolding for `sharesHousehold` (the DTO field, duplicate-rejection logic, and `DuplicateHouseholdException`) already existed; what was missing was the `householdId` assignment and response field.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `householdId` property to the `Owner` response schema (the generator produces `OwnerDto.householdId`). `sharesHousehold` was already defined on `OwnerFields`.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added the persisted `householdId` field (`@Column(name = "household_id")`) with getter/setter.

3. **DB schemas** (`db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — Added the `household_id` column. This is required because tests run on hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema is driven entirely by these files.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — Compute and assign the household id on create via a new `householdId(lastName, address)` helper. It's a **deterministic** function of the normalized last name + address (same trim/collapse-whitespace/lowercase rule already used by `rejectDuplicateHousehold`), formatted `HH-<12 hex of SHA-256>`. Because it's deterministic, every owner in the same household — including one that joins via `sharesHousehold: true` — gets the identical stable identifier, with no need to mutate existing records.

5. **`OwnerMapper`** — Added `@Mapping(target = "householdId", ignore = true)` on the `OwnerFieldsDto → Owner` mapping (a response-only field, mirroring `customerCode`); the `Owner → OwnerDto` direction maps automatically.

The existing behavior is preserved: when `sharesHousehold` is false/omitted, a same-lastName-and-address create is still rejected with 409; when true, the create is allowed and the shared `householdId` is returned.
